links.comparator_used: AI-assisted mammography reading with BI-RADS-like recommendation but no saliency heatmaps
links.outcome: Automation bias and anchoring-related revision bias in manipulated (perturbed AI advice) cases
links.effect: Automation bias 65/180 (36.1%) to 32/180 (17.8%); anchoring bias 61/180 (33.9%) to 31/180 (17.2%); aOR 0.56 (95% CI 0.44-0.71) for automation bias and aOR 0.61 (95% CI 0.48-0.78) for anchoring bias
links.tradeoff: XAI reduced but did not eliminate bias; less experienced radiologists remained particularly susceptible to bias.
links.quote: With XAI, these rates decreased to 32/180 (17.8%) and 31/180 (17.2%), respectively.

design_hint: saliency-based explainable AI heatmaps to mitigate automation and anchoring bias
